headline: Dolly Khanna buys stake in Rain Industries and trims Chennai Petroleum
hook: Dolly Khanna rejigs her top portfolio
summary: Ace investor Dolly Khanna acquired a 1.72% stake in Rain Industries during the July-September quarter, positioning it as her second-largest holding. Concurrently, she reduced her shareholding in Chennai Petroleum Corporation, which continues to be her largest disclosed investment. She also increased her position in Savera Industries during the same period. Retail investors tracking celebrity portfolio movements can note these shifts in specialty chemical and refining exposures.
why_it_matters: Retail investors often mimic prominent investor portfolio adjustments.
winners_losers: Rain Industries gains / Chennai Petroleum hurt
